item.text: {"record_id":"http://www.loc.gov/item/98517503/","description":"Color silkscreen poster for the Federal Theatre Project’s presentation of Theodore Pratt’s “Big Blow” at Maxine Elliott’s Theatre in New York City. Richard Halls is credited as artist and the Federal Theatre Project as sponsor. The catalog describes a woman and man struggling against gale-force winds. Dated between 1936 and 1939; a verso stamp reads June 28, 1939. Part of the Work Projects Administration Poster Collection.","evidence_fields":["Description","Title","Creators","Medium","Date_text","Notes"],"limitations":["The underlying item was not examined; depicted content follows the catalog description.","Date is qualified as between 1936 and 1939; the verso stamp does not establish the creation date."]}
